lines.text: Moses tells Israel not to cut themselves or shave their foreheads for the dead, because they are holy to the LORD.
Israel may eat animals with a split hoof that chew the cud, but the pig does not chew the cud.
Of the creatures in the water, Israel may eat only those with fins and shells.
Israel must set aside a tenth of their produce each year and burn it on the altar before the LORD.
Every three years, Israel lays up a tenth within their gates for the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow.
